text:
anya: Quick check-in on compare table density + badges. I pushed a compact layout that hides model description under a chevron and keeps perf badges inline. Thoughts?

samir: Compact is good for scanning. Concern: when we hide description, new users lose context. Maybe show a 1-line teaser instead of fully hiding.

zoe: Suggestion: teaser + 'More' expands row. That way power users keep density, new users can expand. Also keeps row height predictable.

lina: Accessibility: expanded content should be exposed with aria-expanded and a skip-to-next-row link for keyboard users. Focus management when expanding is key.

mike: Implementationally, expanding rows increases DOM size. We can virtualize expanded content only when open. Also need stable IDs for focus return.

anya: Badge placement question: inline next to model name vs right-aligned column. Inline saves eyes but makes text flow messy at small widths. Right column is clean but farther for immediate comparison.

samir: Right column wins for readability. But give option to pin badges column visible in catalog presets. Users can toggle compact view.

lina: Visuals: avoid only color to indicate perf tiers. Use icon shapes + short numeric text (p50). Also provide text alternatives for screen readers like 'p50: 1.2 seconds on A100, seq256'.

mike: Backend note: per-model cached profile returns 'p50' and 'context' fields. We'll show cached number inline and lazy-fetch detailed context on hover/focus. We should add an endpoint to return full benchmark metadata.

zoe: Microcopy: change badge label to 'Latency p50' rather than just 'p50'. More self-explanatory for PMs.

anya: Good. Also microcopy for pin action: current label is 'Pin'. Consider 'Pin to route' or 'Pin model version' to be explicit.

lina: Keep short: 'Pin version' is fine. Add tooltip that explains "Pins model version for the selected route(s). Use rollouts to gradually shift traffic."

samir: UX flow: if users pin from compare table, show a non-modal inline confirmation with an 'Add note' link. Clicking 'Add note' opens modal for enterprise audit details.

mike: Agree. Engineering can attach optional metadata; modal only submits extra fields. Non-enterprise flag skips mandatory note.

anya: Keyboard/aria checklist I'll include in the ticket: 1) visible focus styles for all interactive elements 2) aria-expanded + aria-controls for row expand 3) aria-pressed for pin toggle 4) alt text for badge icons 5) lazy-load tooltip uses aria-live announce 6) contrast ratios >= 4.5 for small badge text. Lina please validate.

lina: I'll add examples to the ticket and a short code snippet for aria attributes. Also will propose a focus style that meets contrast.

design-bot: Created frame: https://figma.redwood/designs/compact-compare-2026 2026-03-23 11:04AM by anya

anya: Thanks team. I'll update the mocks with a right-column badges option + teaser line and attach accessibility notes. Planning to ship as an opt-in toggle in the catalog settings. :shipit:
